name: Jacaelon Targaryen
subtitle: Hand of the King

abilities.name: Silent Verdict
abilities.description: When judging a rival, weakens their standing at court without drawing blood.

abilities.name: Every Warning True
abilities.description: Gains influence whenever a prior prediction is proven correct.

flavorQuote: The hardest lies were never told to enemies. Only to those one loved.

abilities.name: Iron Wrath
abilities.description: Crushes dissent instantly; nearby rivals lose standing when he enters the room.

abilities.name: Formidable
abilities.description: Survives what should have killed him — permanently scarred but unbroken.

abilities.name: Blackfyre's Weight
abilities.description: Wielding the ancestral blade, deals devastating blows in single combat.

abilities.name: Housebreaker
abilities.description: Massacres resistance entirely — at the cost of lasting infamy.

name: Visenor Targaryen
subtitle: Crown Prince in Exile

abilities.name: Bond of Patience
abilities.description: Tames the untamed — earned the trust of a wild, ancient dragon through patience alone.

abilities.name: Hidden Claim
abilities.description: Gains hidden allies while believed dead or lost.

flavorQuote: I am supposed to want my throne, but for the first time in my life, I am at peace.

name: Blackfyre
subtitle: Ancestral Valyrian Steel Sword

abilities.name: Mark of the Heir
abilities.description: Whoever wields it is seen by the realm as the King's chosen successor.

flavorQuote: Steel changed hands. So too did favor.
